caseName: California Department of Corrections v. Morales
caseNameFull: California Department of Corrections v. Ramon Morales

opinions.text: C. A. 9th Cir. [Certiorari granted, 512 U. S. 1287.] Motion of respondent for appointment of counsel granted, and it is ordered that James R. Asperger, Esq., of Los Angeles, Cal., be appointed to serve as counsel for respondent in this case.
